page_title: 🍓 Berrry - Make tiny web apps with AI

sources.entry: Berrry - AI-powered platform that transforms Twitter posts and Reddit content into functional web applications using code generation.

summary.name: Berrry
summary.one_liner: Berrry is a platform that turns a plain-language description, or a post on Reddit or Twitter, into a working tiny web app using AI, with a gallery of live apps that can be remixed.
use_cases: Generate a small web app from a text description
Remix and modify existing community apps
Turn a Reddit or Twitter post into a working app
Build a quick custom tool without writing code
Prototype a browser-based mini game or utility
Create a live app via a Telegram bot
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a gallery of over 6,000 live apps that visitors can browse and remix. Users describe a new app in text, and the page claims it goes live in minutes (about 3.9 minutes on average, per the page). Apps can be created by posting on r/BerrryComputer or by chatting with a Telegram bot, and external agents can publish apps via a /skill.md file. The page mentions live editing, version control, and professional export options. No signup is required, per the page.
notable: Remix any app in the live gallery of 6,000+ apps
Creates apps from Reddit or Twitter posts or a Telegram bot chat
Agents can publish live apps through a /skill.md file
No signup required, according to the page
caveats: Pricing and export tier details are not stated on the page
Export options are mentioned but not described
